title: A definition for "AI agent bill of materials" (accepted in the taxonomy, definition pending)
author: smcd-personal

inline_text:
The taxonomy workstream has "AI agent bill of materials" (alias AI-BOM) as one of this group's terms, accepted with its definition pending. Under the process in ws-taxonomy-landscape#83, the defining PR comes from this group's delegate, so here is a proposal for whoever carries it. Change anything.

**Definition (one sentence):** "A machine-readable inventory of what an AI agent is built from and relies on, covering its models, the harness around them, the tools it can call and the third-party software beneath them, each with its supplier and version."

**Scope note:** "It extends a software bill of materials, which lists software components, to the parts that decide how an agent behaves. The EU Cyber Resilience Act defines a software bill of materials as 'a formal record containing details and supply chain relationships of components included in the software elements of a product with digital elements' (Art. 3(39)) and requires manufacturers to draw one up 'covering at the very least the top-level dependencies' (Annex I, Part II, point (1)), from 11 December 2027. The EU AI Act asks the technical documentation of a high-risk system to describe any 'recourse to pre-trained systems or tools provided by third parties and how those were used, integrated or modified by the provider' (Annex IV, point 2(a)). Neither text uses the phrase; the term names the inventory both point at. Formats that already carry model and dataset components include SPDX 3.0's AI profile and CycloneDX's ML-BOM, so the term implies no particular format."

**Related terms:** Harness, Skill, Traceability.

Sources, at the official text:
- Cyber Resilience Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/2847: [Art. 3(39)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj/eng#art_3), [Annex I, Part II, point (1)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj/eng#anx_I), [Art. 13(24)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj/eng#art_13), [Annex VII](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj/eng#anx_VII); it applies from 11 December 2027 ([Art. 71(2)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj/eng#art_71))
- AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689: [Annex IV, point 2(a)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng#anx_IV). [Art. 25(4)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1689/oj/eng#art_25), on the written agreement with third parties that supply tools, services, components or processes to a high-risk system, is the related duty; the Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) amends that article
- [SPDX 3.0.1 AI profile](https://spdx.github.io/spdx-spec/v3.0.1/model/AI/AI/); [CycloneDX ML-BOM](https://cyclonedx.org/capabilities/mlbom/)

I'll be on Thursday's WG-GRR call if useful.
